_comment: Official large-monster counts per game, used by tools/audit.py to gauge whether monster-hunter-DB's coverage is complete. Numbers are the franchise-recognized totals (large monsters only), cross-checked against the Monster Hunter Fandom wiki per-game 'Monsters' pages and community tallies. Update these if Capcom adds monsters or if a count is found inaccurate. Keys are the short game code (games[].game in the built monsters.json); MHW/MHRise roll their expansions (Iceborne/Sunbreak) into one entry, matching how the roster stores them (mhwi/mhrs rows share the mhw/mhrise display).
